summary: This is a package.json file that configures a Node.js project for connecting to Oracle databases. It specifies the project metadata, defines how to run the application, and declares that the project depends on the oracledb library version 6.3.0 or compatible newer versions.

explanations.10: The caret (^) before the version number means npm will install version 6.3.0 or any newer version up to (but not including) version 7.0.0, allowing for automatic bug fixes and minor updates.
